agreed upon by the National Govemment and the NPC to make the
idle portions of the property productive; provided, finally, that all
proposed projects to be undertaken by the lAC shall comply with
the existing laws, rules and regulati-ons goveming the use of

affecting the property, particularly its developed portion, to ensure
the protection of whatever rights the present occupants have over
the land in order to achieve a feasible and acceptable turnover of
the property to its rightful owners;

The NPC shall provide
a Secretariat
for the lAC. Expenses
by the lAC, including
the honoraria
for its members,
which shall not
.exceed Six Thousand
(P6, 000. 00) Pesos a month, chargeable
against the funds
of the NPC, subject
to availability
and applicable
accounting
rules and regulations.

The Inter-Agency Committee shall submit a report to the
President for information
and/ or disposition
sixty (60) days from
issuance hereof.

All orders, issuances, rules and regulations or parts thereof
inconsistent
with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this
year of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and Ninety-Seven.
